layouts.macbook_container: sticky top-0 h-screen w-full flex items-center justify-center overflow-hidden
layouts.callout: absolute z-50 flex flex-col gap-2 max-w-xs

motion.macbook_scroll: useTransform to map scrollYProgress to scale (0.9 to 1.05) and rotateX (10deg to 0deg) for cinematic framing.
motion.callout_entrance: Staggered fade-in (opacity 0 to 1, y 10 to 0) tied to active scene index.

components.MacBookShell: Renders a CSS/HTML based MacBook frame or uses the existing InvestorLaptopDemo.jsx. Must have a responsive wrapper.
components.DemoWorkspace: Contains the 9 product surfaces. Controlled by active scene index.
components.SceneCallout: Displays the Verb (e.g., UNDERSTAND), description, and Human Checkpoint badge.
components.HumanCheckpoint: A specific UI badge indicating human-in-the-loop (e.g., 'HUMAN REVIEW REQUIRED' in mono font with a pulsing dot).

implementation_blueprint.macbook_composition_and_motion: MacBook sits sticky center-screen. On scroll, it subtly scales up (0.95 to 1.05) to pull the viewer into the product. SVG connector lines draw from the callout text into specific coordinates of the MacBook screen.

default_5_acts.description: Maps intent to enterprise data realities and permissions.
Halts for human validation and override.
Executes approved actions across integrated systems.

implementation_blueprint.visible_capability_verbs: Use stark, bold uppercase verbs (UNDERSTAND, GROUND, PLAN, REVIEW, ACT). Replace abstract internal names (Onyx, AIGIS) with these action-oriented verbs. Add a distinct 'HUMAN IN THE LOOP' visual indicator for the REVIEW phase.
implementation_blueprint.responsive_strategy: On desktop: Full MacBook frame with flanking callouts. On mobile: Remove the MacBook hardware bezel. Show only the DemoWorkspace UI full-width to maximize readability, with callouts overlaid or stacked below in a fixed panel.
implementation_blueprint.cleanup: Remove all references to the abstract system-map nodes (Enterprise Search, Onyx, AIGIS, Colanode, DeerFlow) from the visual UI. Ensure internal names are not visible to the user.

universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: Do not use generic AI slop. Adhere strictly to the monochrome, high-contrast Palantir AIP aesthetic.
Ensure the gateway and persona selector remain untouched as requested.
Never use `transition: all`. Use specific transitions.
Use backdrop-blur for floating panels to ensure text contrast without muddying the background.
Avoid transparent backgrounds where content scrolls underneath.
Implement Sonner for any toast notifications.
